notes: Read all 170 source lines before editing and preserved the useStatusLiveSSE hook name, the snapshot/state/lastUpdateAt state, the reconnect() callback, the exact GET /api/v1/status/live endpoint default, and the StatusSeverity/StatusV1Snapshot/StatusLiveState/UseStatusLiveSSEOptions/UseStatusLiveSSEResult types (L24-68) verbatim with snake_case JSON keys.
